items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: We had -- Al Sears was with us.

ctx.x: Did you do any arranging for that group?
Yes, I did for the shows and I did some of the arrangements we played at Smalls. We had -- Al Sears was with us. We had -- anybody that you might know now -- no,

I don't think anybody that you know now, but I did some of the arranging for the band in those days, too, as well as the Apollo Theater. That's about as much as I can elaborate on Snowden. I think it's worth mentioning about another one of our great leaders. I mentioned his name before. I've been connected with Fletcher from his time -- first arrival in New York up to the time he passed. But I remember -- Fletcher made a lot of mistakes as we all have, and they always say Fletcher died of frustration, and a lot…
